dimension_rules.title: Literature inventory exists
dimension_rules.scope: Checks for a nonempty, untruncated paper inventory.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Literature coverage, relevance, source quality, or truth.

dimension_rules.title: Claim locators resolve structurally
dimension_rules.scope: Checks typed evidence links and source locator fields.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Semantic entailment or whether the passage supports a claim.

dimension_rules.title: Evidence provenance fields are present
dimension_rules.scope: Checks typed origin, source identity state, and epistemic state fields.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Real-world source identity or epistemic correctness.

dimension_rules.title: Counterevidence edges preserve polarity
dimension_rules.scope: Checks explicit contradiction edges and endpoint references.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Whether the contradiction is substantively valid.

dimension_rules.title: Hypothesis fields are complete
dimension_rules.scope: Checks nonempty structural fields and required list presence.

dimension_rules.title: Experiment design and budget arithmetic are complete
dimension_rules.scope: Checks declared controls, analysis fields, and checked budget sums.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Power, feasibility, fairness, or scientific validity.

dimension_rules.title: Uncertainty fields are explicit and bounded
dimension_rules.scope: Checks declared uncertainty grades and explicit epistemic status.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Calibration or whether uncertainty is justified.

dimension_rules.title: Snapshot identity and replay state are explicit
dimension_rules.scope: Checks digest-bound snapshot identity and reports unavailable source replay.
dimension_rules.cannot_establish: Reproducibility of unavailable source documents or scientific findings.
